Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Noal McDonald <dhar...@my-deja.com> wrote:
> hamd...@my-deja.com wrote:
> > And can non-bleeding Allies recruit retainers or equipment to give
> > them bleed - eg Renegade Garou equipping Tasha Morgan or JS Simmons
> > Esq and Laptop Computer and Inverarie: Scotland?
>
> With the exception of Inveraray, Scotland, which is only usable by
> vampires, yes.

Correct.
Note: there's a difference between a non-bleeding ally (Hell Hound,
for example) and an ally with a bleed of zero (Garou).
A Garou, even with no equipment, is free to take a bleed action
(and will bleed for zero, by default).

Messages.Body:
X_Ze...@email.msn.com wrote:

> LSJ <vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote:
> > Also, Inveraray explicitly provides its +bleed to vampires, not
> > allies.
>
> So even if Inveray with 3 counters on it (making it +3 bleed) was on a
> vampire, and you then moved it using Kine Dominance, Disputed Location
> or Heidleburg Castle onto say a renagade Garou; the Inveraray Castle
> would then lose its bleed bonus? That seems a little counter-intuitive.

Go by card text, not intuition.

Inveraray has no bleed bonus - the vampire with it has a bleed bonus,
by explicit card text. (The Castle cannot be used to move locquipment,
nor can it be used to move anything to or from an ally, BTW.)
